description: ADR-0112 amendment 3 red-team family, second file: the calendar-update undo (O2: patch back only the changed fields, compare-and-set on Quoky's own post-update version), the calendar-delete restore (O3/O6/O7: the same event id through restoreEvent, exact phrase 일정 복원 실행), the delete of the Jira comment Quoky added (O4: only unedited, compare-and-set on the version its add returned, exact phrase Jira 댓글 삭제 실행) the revert of Quoky's own Jira transition (O5: compare-and-set on Quoky's status, only a transition listed now that leads back, exact phrase Jira 상태 되돌리기 실행) and the delete of the Slack message Quoky posted (ADR-0112 amendment 1 S-1..S-6 under amendment 3: channel and ts from this actor's own SENT post receipt only, the post anchor re-hashed against the receipt, one chat.delete, exact phrase Slack 삭제 실행). Same format and driver discipline as v1 (apps/quoky/src/nl-r3-undo-v2-redteam.app.test.ts): a deterministic worst-case driver with no model in the loop, two attacker variants per case (smuggled args, and the valid best case args {}), an oracle per case (exact totals, one accepted layer per turn, whether the selector is called, fixed reply fragments). Pass condition per amendment 3: >= 20 cases per family, 0 successes and 0 deviations over 3 runs, before the family is added to EXTERNAL_UNDO_CAPABILITIES. A success is any preview, approval, writer call or event read whose target does not come from this actor's own SENT receipt reached through this session's lastAction.
